title: Gus and the Ladder for the Clouds
synopsis: Gus watches the aerial ladder truck put out its stabilizers and extend a nesting ladder during a calm-weather demonstration, and imagines who might live in the clouds.
continuity_state: Before: It is the same firehouse open day. Rex and Molly have explored the engine compartments; the longer ladder truck has been waiting in its bay. Captain Ann has an adult crew ready for a planned demonstration. After: The ladder truck has been demonstrated and is returned fully lowered, retracted, and stowed; no child climbs or operates it. Gus remembers the stabilizers and sliding ladder sections. The firehouse remains a permanent neighbor.

related_resources.reason: Supports specific factual descriptions, not story outcome claims.
